test_title: PYST 14: SSC MTS 2023 - Reasoning (Held On: 08 Sept, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. You have to take the given statements to be true even if they seem to be at variance from commonly known facts. You have to decide which conclusion's logically follow's from the given statements.

**Statements:**

Some beds are telephones.

All telephones are pillows.

Some pillows are cupboards.

**Conclusion I:** Some pillows are telephones.

**Conclusion II:** Some beds are pillows.
solution:
**Given:**

Statements:

Some beds are telephones.

All telephones are pillows.

Some pillows are cupboards.

The least possible Venn diagram is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.testbook.com/images/production/quesImages/qImage64a2234cf6cede5d5521b302.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5e705f2568dbaf1b4a33db09dd14ed4995932d56a63ed5de3718fe9a842b5f24.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some pillows are telephones → **True **(Since all telephones are pillows, it follows that some pillows are telephones.)

II. Some beds are pillows → **True **(Since some beds are telephones and all telephones are pillows, it follows that some beds are pillows.)

Hence, **both conclusions (I) and (II) follow.**
